verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented, registrable outbound HTTP webhook callbacks for Devin events. The REST API, MCP server and Slack/Teams tagging are inbound control surfaces or chat integrations, not webhook subscriptions, so they earn no credit. The axis applies to a cloud agent platform, so missing evidence means none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
